scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @planning-poker/api && npm run build --workspace @planning-poker/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e --workspace @planning-poker/web
